notes: Verified complete by grepping for other covenant-ratio keywords (Fixed Charge/Debt Service/Interest Coverage, Minimum Liquidity, Net Worth, Current Ratio) -- none found; this document is leverage-ratio-only. Running the eval against this gold set should surface that entry as a false positive if the fix hasn't been applied. `citation_contains` anchors for the two Incremental-Facility-basket entries were tightened to the number-bearing phrase itself ('does not exceed (x) N.NN:1.00') after a cross-model eval run showed a looser, lead-in-text anchor (e.g. 'in the case of ... unsecured') spuriously miss a model that quoted the same clause starting closer to the number -- anchors should key on the fact being verified, not on incidental quoting-boundary choices any one model happened to make.
